source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check Chassis information and detail information, then compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES queries only an assumed FRU_FE_1 URI with insecure curl and declares FE_1 through FE_4 analogous; it projects three fields and omits all per-position WebUI/IPMI comparisons.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION restores four-position mapping, fitted/absent semantics and complete evidence but treats the required topology/reference package as an unresolved decision.

old_problem: The original shortcut covers at most one of four explicitly indexed front-end FRUs. Numeric names are not guaranteed to align across physical position, WebUI, Redfish and IPMI, and a valid FE_1 record supplies no evidence for FE_2, FE_3 or FE_4. The historical review identified this gap but did not parameterize the four-position map and build population.
disposition_reason: Build an explicit FE_1, FE_2, FE_3 and FE_4 topology/population matrix, bind each position independently to its physical identity and exact IPMI/UI/API objects, and execute the complete source-required parity check for every fitted position. Unfitted positions may pass only through approved build/SPEC evidence and defined absent behavior; no position is inferred from FE_1.
decision_basis: XLSX row 956, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 957 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 957 / variant e73b42cb20a13be1.

The Items field explicitly enumerates FE_1~4. ED-02 and ED-19 require all four source identities/coverage positions to remain independently auditable; the DeepSeek phrase '1..4 analogous' cannot satisfy them.

An absent member can mean intentionally unfitted, unsupported, undiscovered, inaccessible or failed. Only the approved build population and interface-specific absence contract can distinguish those states.
IPMI FRU areas and DMTF Assembly/Chassis fields support each member's content validation, while the Project FE topology is authoritative for cross-interface numeric mapping.

ED-08, ED-17, ED-21 and ED-30 retain actual WebUI and logs; ED-33 through ED-38 permit parameterized read-only execution while forbidding generated sibling URIs/device IDs and partial-interface substitution.

test_case.test_name: Validate FE_1 through FE_4 as four independent front-end FRU records
test_case.purpose: Account for FE_1, FE_2, FE_3 and FE_4 independently, prove every fitted physical front-end module maps uniquely to its own IPMI FRU and actual WebUI/API inventory record, validate all applicable FRU fields against the per-position Project build record, and distinguish approved unfitted positions from missing or failed inventory without mutation.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/chassis identity and approved FE_1~4 physical topology/build population stating fitted, intentionally unfitted and unsupported positions
Per-position durable identity and complete enumerated IPMI FRU mapping with device ID, interface, channel, bridge/address and documented aliases
Per-position Redfish Chassis/Assembly or approved OEM relationships discovered from the service and actual WebUI Inventory and LEDs row/detail mapping
FE FRU area/field layout including required Board/Product/Chassis/MultiRecord/custom fields and per-position allowed differences
Per-position manufacturing/BOM/asset authority with expected part, serial, revision and custom values plus encoding/blank/padding/freshness rules
Interface-specific expected absent representation and trusted/protected credential, TLS, redaction and evidence-storage configuration
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify the immutable target and approved FE_1~4 population. Enumerate the complete IPMI FRU device set and actual Redfish inventory members before selection; bind each logical FE index independently through its approved durable physical relationships and do not derive an ID/URI for FE_2~4 from FE_1. For every fitted FE_n, run only `ipmitool ... fru print <mapped-FE_n-ID>`, retrieve the complete mapped Redfish/OEM record, and open/capture the actual rendered WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs row/detail. Decode every applicable FRU area and compare raw and approved-normalized values with that position's Project record. For each approved unfitted/unsupported position, verify the exact expected absence behavior in every interface and preserve the SPEC/build evidence; keep missing, unauthorized, timeout and parse error distinct. Check one-to-one uniqueness across all four. Repeat read fingerprints only; do not write/edit FRU, clear logs, refresh inventory, reset, reboot or power-cycle.
test_case.expected_result: FE_1, FE_2, FE_3 and FE_4 are each accounted exactly once. Every expected fitted position has a unique physical/IPMI/UI/API binding, complete structurally valid FRU data and exact field-level agreement with its own manufacturing record and rendered WebUI. Every approved unfitted/unsupported position matches the documented absence representation across interfaces. No position is missing, duplicated, swapped or extrapolated; no unexplained extra/stale/error state or system mutation occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an explicit four-row matrix, one-to-one mapping for every fitted FE, full `ipmitool fru print` and actual WebUI evidence per fitted position, complete applicable-field parity and authoritative absence proof per unfitted position. FE_1 evidence, a count of four, synthesized sibling URIs or matching common product fields cannot pass other positions. Missing/duplicate/swapped FE, unapproved absence, parser/checksum error, missing required field or unexplained per-position mismatch is FAIL. Missing topology/population/reference is NOT READY rather than Pending; N/A requires approved build/SPEC evidence.
safety_gate: Use only protected certificate-verified reads and approved IPMI routing; no process-visible secrets or insecure-TLS acceptance evidence.
Enumerate and bind FE_1~4 independently. Never increment a URI, FRU ID, channel or slot number from FE_1 to locate siblings.
Allow only IPMI FRU enumeration and mapped `fru print`; prohibit FRU write/edit/upgEkey, raw storage writes, log clear, reset, reboot and power actions.
Do not translate missing, unauthorized, timeout or parse failure into unfitted/unsupported; only Project population/SPEC evidence can establish legitimate absence.
Preserve complete raw per-position artifacts and actual rendered WebUI evidence before normalization/redaction; retain stable member tokens for swap/duplicate detection.
Stop on any ambiguous, duplicate or cross-position mapping and do not automatically try adjacent IDs or resources.
expected_evidence: Approved FE_1~4 physical topology/population matrix and immutable target identity
Complete enumerated IPMI FRU and Redfish inventory sets plus explicit per-FE physical/device/member/UI mapping
For each fitted FE, full timestamped `ipmitool fru print`, complete mapped API record and actual rendered WebUI row/detail with protected hashes
Four-row applicable-area/field comparison matrix with raw, normalized, expected and outcome values and cross-position uniqueness checks
For each unfitted/unsupported FE, authoritative build/SPEC evidence and exact interface-specific absence observations distinct from failures
Pre/post fingerprints, preserved SEL/audit logs, no-write/no-clear/no-reset/no-power proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On an ambiguous/swapped/duplicate FE mapping, unexpected absence, decode/checksum error or field disagreement, stop and preserve/redact evidence, then obtain the authoritative topology or reference. Do not infer or trial adjacent IDs, write FRU, clear logs, reset BMC, reboot, power-cycle or automatically retry against another FE.

source_conflict.reason: The Master consistently requires FE_1~4 inventory correctness and IPMI parity. DeepSeek's FE_1-only implementation is a coverage omission, not a contradictory source requirement.

blocked.reason: The four-position objective and safe read method are clear. Topology, population, mapping and expected records are finite Project prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: FE_1~4 physical/population map; per-position IPMI/UI/API identities; applicable FRU fields; per-position manufacturing values; authoritative absence behavior; normalization, freshness, trust and redaction.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ-ONLY FOUR-POSITION FRU_FE REVIEW ONLY; NO IPMI, REDFISH, WEBUI OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
